name: Sink gasket 31 / 51
description: Flat, thin sink gasket: 31 mm inner and 51 mm outer diameter. A flat web 1.2 mm thick, flat out to a radius of 22 mm, then a short curve and a 45 degree ramp up to the rim (about 3 mm high) that meets the sealing surface. Nothing is steeper than 45 degrees, so it prints without supports. Print in TPU, flat side down.
